excerpt: Explore the 2026 Sasquatch Pro Results, featuring winners Dallas Botchway, Ashley Howells, and Ashley Kaltwasser.
content:
Image embed via Instagram @ashleykfit

The 2026 Sasquatch Pro took place on Saturday, September 19, in Federal Way, Washington, bringing Men’s Physique, Figure, and Bikini competitors to the IFBB Pro League stage. Dallas Botchway claimed the Men’s Physique title, while Ashley Howells emerged victorious in Figure. Bikini GOAT Ashley Kaltwasser notched her 60th professional victory, one week before she will attempt to become the first four-time Bikini Olympia champion. 

Event Information

Date: September 19, 2026
Location: Federal Way, Washington
Divisions: Men’s Physique, Women’s Figure, Women’s Bikini

2026 Sasquatch Pro Winners

  • Men’s Physique: Dallas Botchway
  • Women’s Figure: Ashley Howells
  • Women’s Bikini: Ashley Kaltwasser
